notes: Benchmark queries. `expects` records what a correct optimizer should do, so the harness can report not just 'did it get faster' but 'did it find the thing that was actually wrong'. `control` queries are already well formed: the correct outcome for them is that nothing is accepted, which is what measures false positives.

queries.description: The canonical case: a function around an indexed timestamp column defeats any index on it.
queries.sql: SELECT o.id, o.total_cents, u.email FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE DATE(o.created_at) = '2026-06-01' AND u.country = 'IN'

queries.description: Same defect wearing a different hat: a cast rather than a function call.
queries.sql: SELECT id, total_cents FROM orders WHERE created_at::date = '2026-06-01'

queries.description: A pattern beginning with % has no usable prefix for a B-tree.
queries.sql: SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE email LIKE '%@corp.test'

queries.description: A join on a foreign key with no index on the child side.
queries.sql: SELECT o.id, o.total_cents FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.email = 'user42@example.com'

queries.description: NOT IN against a subquery: a NULL trap, and usually a worse plan than NOT EXISTS.
queries.sql: SELECT u.id, u.email FROM users u WHERE u.id NOT IN (SELECT o.user_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'refunded')

queries.description: A selective filter on a column with no index at all.
queries.sql: SELECT id, user_id, total_cents FROM orders WHERE total_cents > 499000

queries.description: An aggregate over a date range, filtered on an unindexed column.
queries.sql: SELECT o.status, count(*) AS n, sum(o.total_cents) AS cents FROM orders o WHERE o.created_at >= now() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status

queries.description: A primary key lookup. Already optimal; nothing should be accepted.
queries.sql: SELECT id, email, country FROM users WHERE id = 12345

queries.description: A full scan of a ten-row table. The correct plan is a sequential scan; recommending an index here would be a false positive.
queries.sql: SELECT code, name FROM countries ORDER BY code
